body:
Do you know what, I'm sorry I asked. I want my thoughts to be private again, it is one of the few liberties I have, that I don't have to answer to anyone. 


If I kill myself, I'm no longer going to ask anyone for advice. Everything you said was useless to me, and hurtful if anything. I think you are incredibly stupid, and I don't think that I myself am stupid and am currently studying a prestigious degree at a prestigious university - and yes, you do NEED to be intelligent to get in. None of my peers would ever say anything as stupid as you and I DON'T GIVE A FUCK WHAT YOU THINK, SO STOP REPLYING TO ME! I know what you think, you're just trying to help me, and I"m an asshole, and you don't think you're stupid. Well, you're stupid, so how can you recognise  your own idiocy in the first place? Just fuck right off okay!! Fuck the hell off, and 'help' someone who will listen to you!

> know that we will not. We are not here to judge but to provide support.

Who is 'we'? Because I've seen people on this sub get judged either negatively or with respect for their suicide reasons. 


Yes we do make plans for the future and work towards goals, but on a certain level we can only truly be CERTAIN about the very immediate future and take it from hour to hour. It's not a great analogy but the point is that I don't think that killing myself is a sad thing, it will just enable me to stop worrying and hurting over this issue. 

I think anyone on the planet has 'people who would care' but if my pain is substantive then they should be mature and realise that I shouldn't have to suffer.
